chain_words.nuance: impatient and wound up, often repeatedly
general feeling of displeasure or hostility
very strong anger that is hard to control
anger so intense it provokes an outburst

explanation: These words all express anger but with different intensities, from mild annoyance to an outburst of rage.

usage_notes.difference: 'Annoyed' describes a minor, passing irritation, while 'furious' describes anger strong enough to be visible and hard to control.
